title: Flashcards: Where it is official, Asia
intro: Flip each card about Asia. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: In which country is Azerbaijani an official language?
cards.explain: Azerbaijani is an official language of Azerbaijan.

cards.front: In which country is Bengali an official language?
cards.explain: Bengali is an official language of Bangladesh.

cards.front: In which country is Armenian an official language?
cards.explain: Armenian is an official language of Armenia.

cards.front: In which countries is Malay (macrolanguage) an official language?
cards.explain: Malay (macrolanguage) is an official language of Brunei Darussalam, Malaysia, Singapore.

cards.front: In which country is Tetum an official language?
